adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that in the `next` action (lines 30-38), `group.set('offset', offset)` is called before `group.findMembers()`. Looking at the `findMembers` method in `discourse/models/group.js`, it makes an AJAX call and updates properties including `offset` only on success. If the AJAX call fails, the offset has already been changed on the model, but the members array won't be updated. The UI would show the new page number (computed from offset) but display stale member data. This is a real race condition/error handling bug.
